# Flopper.io - AI GPU Database | Compare AI Accelerators

> Flopper.io is your go-to resource for comparing AI GPU specifications and performance metrics from top manufacturers like NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel. With real TFLOPS and power data sourced directly from official specifications, developers can make informed decisions for their AI projects.

## Core Features
- [AI GPU Database](https://flopper.io/): Compare detailed specifications and performance of various AI accelerators including NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs.
- [About Flopper.io](https://flopper.io/about): Discover the mission behind Flopper.io and how we provide a centralized database of GPU performance for AI training and inference.
- [Contact Us](https://flopper.io/contact): Reach out for partnership inquiries, data corrections, or any questions regarding our GPU database.
- [How to Use](https://flopper.io/how-to): Learn how to navigate Flopper.io and make the most of our GPU comparison tools.

## Free Tools
- [AI Power Translator](https://flopper.io/tools/power-translator): Translate gigawatt (GW) power allocations into actual GPU system counts. Demystify what "10 GW" means in concrete hardware terms.

## System Configurations
- [System Configurations](https://flopper.io/systems): Explore and compare multi-GPU systems optimized for AI workloads, including NVIDIA DGX and HGX configurations.
- [Compare Systems](https://flopper.io/compare-systems): Side-by-side comparison of various multi-GPU setups to assess performance, power consumption, and specifications.
- [NVIDIA GB200 NVL72](https://flopper.io/systems/nvidia-gb200-nvl72): Next-generation 72-GPU system with GB200 Blackwell architecture, delivering 5.4 exaFLOPS FP8 performance.
- [NVIDIA GB200 NVL36](https://flopper.io/systems/nvidia-gb200-nvl36): Compact 36-GPU GB200 configuration balancing performance and power efficiency.
- [NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD GB200](https://flopper.io/systems/nvidia-dgx-superpod-gb200): Massive 2,304-GPU SuperPOD configuration delivering over 20 exaFLOPS FP8 performance.

## GPU Comparisons
- [Compare GPUs](https://flopper.io/compare): Select and compare up to four GPUs based on detailed specifications, performance metrics, and power efficiency.
- [GPU News & Updates](https://flopper.io/news): Stay updated with the latest news, benchmarks, and announcements in the world of datacenter GPUs and AI accelerators.

## GPU Specifications
- [AMD Instinct MI325X OAM Specs](https://flopper.io/gpu/amd-instinct-mi325x-oam): Detailed specifications and performance metrics for the AMD Instinct MI325X, including FLOPS, VRAM, and power efficiency.
- [NVIDIA H200 SXM 141GB Specs](https://flopper.io/gpu/nvidia-h200-sxm-141gb): Latest NVIDIA Hopper architecture with expanded HBM3e memory for large-scale AI training.
- [NVIDIA H100 SXM5 80GB Specs](https://flopper.io/gpu/nvidia-h100-sxm5-80gb): Industry-leading AI training GPU with transformer engine and FP8 support.
